items.evidence: Log 35-204: 19 uL master mix (13.25 water, 5 buffer, 0.5 dNTP, 0.25 pol per rxn) plus 1 uL template and 2.5 uL each primer into each well, which gives 25 uL with 0.1 uM primers and 0.5 ng template. Primer and template wells match the design table.

Comments record 98 C 30 s, 34-36 cycles of 10 s at 98 C / 30 s gradient annealing / extension, and 72 C 5 min. Log 206-358 adds 19 uL water, 5 uL rCutSmart and 1 uL DpnI per well. Comments then give 37 C 30 min and 65 C 20 min, followed by a clean-up comment and a pause, in that order.
Log 360-509: each assembly well gets 7 uL water, 2 uL T4 buffer, fragments at 3/2/3/2 uL from the correct PCR wells, and 1 uL gg_enzyme with mixing, giving 20 uL.

The Golden Gate program is recorded as 30 cycles of 37/16 C, then 60 C for 5 min, with the hold at 16 C rather than 4 C. This is a minor deviation, and the other steps are present. The 10 uL elution comment, 5 uL into cells (log 512-549), 30 min ice and 42 C 60 s heat shock, 250 uL LB (log 552-589), 37 C 60 min recovery and kanamycin plating are all there.

Every pick_up_tip in the log is followed by a drop_tip, and a fresh tip is used for each template, primer, fragment and assembly. The single tip used for the master mix only aspirates from the master mix tube.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the paper's PCR, DpnI, Golden Gate and transformation workflow, and the simulator log matches the code. The one deviation is a 16 C hold instead of 4 C after the Golden Gate program, which I judged acceptable, so all items pass.
